# backend/app/workflow_revisions

> 7 files below this folder - current 7, stale 0, todo 0.

| File | Status | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [__init__.py](__init__.py.md) | current | The workflow revisions package. A built workflow is changed by saying what should change, through propose → review → apply. Every change records a restorable version. |
| [diff.py](diff.py.md) | current | A semantic diff between two workflow definitions: steps by id, edges as pairs, config by key, inputs by name. It is what a revision proposal shows the user. |
| [fix_plan.py](fix_plan.py.md) | current | The fix plan of a Refine-with-AI turn: |
| [models.py](models.py.md) | current | The tables for workflow revision proposals and saved definition versions, plus one additive migration. |
| [operations.py](operations.py.md) | current | The edit-operation vocabulary that revisions are expressed in, applied deterministically with no LLM. It does all the rewiring: predecessors and successors, parallel groups, branches, the entry step,  |
| [store.py](store.py.md) | current | Synchronous SQLite persistence for revisions and versions. It returns plain dicts, supersedes stale proposals, keeps a bounded version history with a baseline, and forgets a deleted workflow's history |
| [suggestions.py](suggestions.py.md) | current | One-click revision prompts derived from validation issue codes, with no LLM. When nothing is wrong, it offers general improvements instead. |
